rationales.dm01_user_text_vocab: A keyword/cue vocabulary is matched by raw `in` against lowered user text: the BC-01 incident shape (a keyword firing inside a longer unrelated word, as 'how' did inside 'shower'). The utils/trigger_match chokepoint applies word boundaries and negation; this site does not use it. Retained as accepted debt until the source owner routes it through the chokepoint.
rationales.dm01_enum_string: `"conversational" in str(tone).lower()` tests membership against the string form of an enum or arbitrary object: BC-01's first recorded incident ('crisis' inside str(CrisisLevel.CONVERSATIONAL)), and the catalog's Find line requires `.value` comparison instead. Retained as accepted debt until the source owner compares the value.
rationales.dm01_commit_tags: Commit-subject tags are assigned by raw substring ('wip' also matches 'swipe' or 'wiping'). This is the BC-01 shape against repository text rather than user text, and the impact is limited to tag metadata. Retained as accepted debt until fixed.
rationales.dm01_structured_text: The membership test runs against machine-generated or structured text (an exception message, a generated label, a metadata title or type, a delimiter, or a URL scheme), not a keyword vocabulary over user language. The detector's lowered-text shape matches, but review found no BC-01 misfire mechanism. Accepted as reviewed debt; this is neither a confirmed defect nor a detector false positive, because the detector cannot tell these apart.
rationales.dm01_tooling: A developer or probe script selects rows or keys in its own output. It is not on any runtime path. Accepted as reviewed tooling debt.
rationales.dm01_distinct_literal: A single distinctive literal tested against the current query gates a scoring penalty. Review found no plausible containment in an unrelated word, but the test is still a bare substring by construction. Accepted as reviewed debt.
rationales.dm17_unguarded_apply: This `--apply` store-writing script never calls utils.daemon_guard.daemon_running before its writes (BC-37: a live Daemon re-saves its in-memory stores over the script's changes). Retained as accepted debt until the source owner adds a reviewed guard that runs before every apply-consuming statement.
rationales.dm17_test_classifier_literal: The `data/`-prefixed literal is an argument to, or the expected value of, a pure path-classification or guard function; or it is a snapshot fingerprint label or a tmp-tree assertion. Review found no filesystem write to a live store. Accepted as reviewed debt: the detector's literal rule cannot tell an argument from a write.
rationales.dm18_prompt_gatherer: A prompt-context gatherer turns any retrieval exception into an empty section ([] or ''), so the model and the turn receipt see 'nothing found' when the read actually failed (BC-47; probe backlog Q12). Retained as accepted debt until the source owner makes the failure distinguishable at the gatherer layer.
rationales.dm18_retrieval_manager: A knowledge retrieval or search API returns the same empty value for a genuine empty result and for a raised store or provider error, so every consumer inherits the ambiguity (BC-20/BC-47). Retained as accepted debt until the source owner exposes a failure outcome.
rationales.dm18_memory_read: A memory store read returns the same empty value ([] or None) for 'no rows' and for a raised read, so consolidation, threads, proposals and expansion cannot tell a failed read from an empty store (BC-20/BC-47; the get_ids_by_timestamp_range incident family). Retained as accepted debt until the source owner exposes a failure outcome.
rationales.dm18_write_none: A store WRITE returns None on any exception. Callers cannot tell a deliberately skipped write from a failed one, so a turn, skill, proposal or thread can silently go unpersisted (BC-47 on the write side). Retained as accepted debt until the source owner surfaces write failure.
rationales.dm18_optional_contract: The empty or None return is the function's Optional contract for optional enrichment or an unknown value (no embedding, no candidate, size unknown, no link to follow, no adjustment, layer unavailable). Consumers treat it as 'unavailable', and review found no downstream false negative claim. Accepted as reviewed debt, not a confirmed defect.
rationales.dm18_background_uncertain: On this background or auxiliary path, an LLM, parse or provider failure produces the same empty outcome as 'nothing to extract'. The failure is logged, but this bounded review did not establish its effect on persisted data or user-facing claims. Retained as uncertain accepted debt.
rationales.dm31_component_local: The parameter is a caller-chosen size or a component-local enable flag, not a live external budget or Settings toggle, so its literal default asserts nothing about the world. Accepted as reviewed debt: the name-vocabulary rule cannot tell the difference.
